committee_summary: H.R. 6324, the ``Fiscal Year 2024 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act,'' was introduced by Representative Mike Bost of Illinois, Chairman of the Committee on Veterans' Affairs, on November 9, 2023. The bill would authorize the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to complete certain major medical facility construction projects and authorize the appropriations for each project for Fiscal Year (FY) 2024 in: American Lake, Washington; Dallas, Texas; El Paso, Texas; Perry Point, Maryland; Portland, Oregon; Reno, Nevada; San Diego, California; San Fransisco, California; San Juan, Puerto Rico; St. Louis, Missouri; and West Haven, Connecticut.
